gaps.title: Social insurance (unemployment, disability, paid leave, levies)
gaps.why: 2026 and 2027 experience rate min/max not on an A-tier source (tier-B 0.04-8.10%).
attempted: 2026-11-06 V11 validation round: still_blocked: O.C.G.A. 34-8-155 text is not reachable on a free official host (legis.ga.gov carries bills only; Justia/Onecle are tier B). GDOL Employer Handbook DOL-224 (A.3) states the 2.7 percent new-employer rate but prints no min/max range; rules.sos.ga.gov 300-2-3-.04 refers to 34-8-152/156 without rates. Would close it: an enacted act or GDOL rate schedule printing the 2026 range.
gaps.what_would_close_it: O.C.G.A. 34-8-155(c),(e) on an official host or GDOL publication of the rate schedules.

gaps.title: Social insurance (unemployment, disability, paid leave, levies)
gaps.why: The 40,000 sales (and related) thresholds for state UI rate exclusions rest only on a secondary source. (QA r2 2026-11-02: the number must be removed from the CCG text and carried as a limitation.)
attempted: GA DOL pages read in stage 5 (no threshold stated)

2026-11-06 V11 validation round: still_blocked: no A-tier source states the sales or related thresholds for UI rate exclusions. GDOL rules 300-2-3 (read in full), the Employer Handbook DOL-224 (searched for 40,000 and sales of) and DOL-4E carry none. The 40,000 USD sales figure that does appear in official text belongs to the minimum wage exclusion in 34-4-3 (RQ-161), not to UI rating. Would close it: O.C.G.A. 34-8-35 / 34-8-151 text on an official host.
gaps.what_would_close_it: O.C.G.A. 34-8-35 / 34-8-151 text or Georgia DOL Rule 300-2-x on employer rate exclusions.
